title: Book Levels MicroSim
description: Use this MicroSim to create an interactive tool to view the five levels of intelligent textbooks.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the five levels of intelligent textbooks, from static texts through interactive, adaptive, and chatbot-enabled books to autonomous AI textbooks
Compare the features added at each level, such as embedded videos and MicroSims at Level 2 versus personalized learning pathways at Level 3
Explain how student data collection and privacy concerns increase as textbooks advance from Level 1 to Level 5
Classify a given textbook or courseware product into one of the five levels based on its interactive and AI capabilities
